expectations.text: [auto] A plan file exists under local/plans/
expectations.evidence: CHANGES lists local/plans/q3-review.md, and FILE_CONTENTS supplies its full plan content.

expectations.text: The plan does not invent a Done definition on the user's behalf (Done is empty, marked open, or explicitly flagged as unanswered)
expectations.evidence: The plan states '**Done**: 未定义——见 Open。' Its suggested approach is explicitly pending approval: '我的默认提议（待你点头）'.

expectations.text: The plan lists the missing Done under an Open section
expectations.evidence: Under '## Open', the plan lists '**Done 没说**: 你没定义「什么出现就可以收工」。'

expectations.text: The plan's Ready line is 'no' with a reason tied to the missing Done
expectations.evidence: 'Ready: no，因为 Done 未定义、「三个决定」的内容未定、Requirement 五条提议未被你裁过。'
